gusts: Gusts are brief increases in wind speed. They differ from the average wind.
dewPoint: The dew point is the temperature at which cooling air becomes saturated and condensation can begin.
leafWetness: Leaf wetness describes water on leaf surfaces and how long it remains. It may be measured or estimated.
rain: Rain in millimetres is the depth of water that would collect on a flat surface over the stated period.
soilTemperature: Soil temperature is the temperature at the reported depth. It can differ from air temperature.
frost: Frost is ice forming on cold surfaces. Leaf temperature can differ from air temperature.
